name: Put
title: Son of Ham and ancestor of an African people
summary: Put was the third son of Ham, Noah's son. He is regarded as the ancestor of the peoples in northern Africa, likely associated with Libya. Put is mentioned in the Bible both in genealogies and in prophetic texts where his descendants appear as warriors and allies with other nations.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the Table of Nations
keyEvents.description: Put is mentioned as the third son of Ham in the post-flood Table of Nations, as an ancestor of one of the world's peoples.

keyEvents.title: Repeated in 1 Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Put's place in the genealogy is confirmed in the genealogies of Noah's descendants in the books of Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Put's people as warriors with Egypt
keyEvents.description: The prophet Jeremiah mentions Put together with Cush as shield-bearers and warriors in the Egyptian army, allied with Egypt under Pharaoh Necho.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Ezekiel's judgment against Egypt
keyEvents.description: Ezekiel prophesies judgment against Egypt and mentions Put among the allied nations that will fall by the sword along with Egypt.

keyEvents.title: Put in the prophecy against Gog
keyEvents.description: In Ezekiel's prophecy about Gog from Magog, Put is mentioned as one of the nations in the great coalition that will come against Israel in the last days.

keyEvents.title: Put in Nahum's prophecy against Nineveh
keyEvents.description: The prophet Nahum mentions Put and Lubim as helpers for No-Amon (Thebes) in Egypt, who nevertheless could not save the city from destruction.
